# AblePaine

> AblePaine (AblePaine LLC) is an indie software and game studio in Hartsville, South Carolina, USA. It builds buy-once, offline-first apps and games: no accounts, no subscriptions, no telemetry. Founded 2026.

## Products (in development)

- **PlotMyCash** — personal cash-flow forecasting app for Windows. Recurring income/bills in, projected balance out, one-time what-ifs. Fully offline; user data never leaves the PC. Status: in final testing, launching first.
- **HerdRow** — herd book app for small cattle operations (registrations, breeding, calving, weaning). Status: in development.
- **Breaker's Reach** — co-op survival game. Status: in development; the studio's flagship game.

## Free web tools (live, no account)

- [DoughMatrix](https://doughmatrix.com) — baker's calculation engines: dough hydration, batch scaling, bake scheduling, recipe costing.
- [MicroRadicle](https://microradicle.com) — farm planning engines and a 3,000+ variety seed explorer.
- [Saponis](https://saponis.app) — costing/formulation benches for soap and candle makers.

## Principles

- Buy once: one price, one time; no subscription rent.
- Offline-first: software runs fully on the user's machine.
- No accounts, no telemetry, no data collection.
